mapper.sql: t.id, t.transfer_no, t.from_warehouse_id, t.to_warehouse_id, t.user_id, t.total_quantity, t.total_amount, t.transfer_type, t.status, t.reason, t.audit_time, t.out_time, t.receive_time, t.remark, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.create_time, t.update_time

FROM shop_erp_inventory_transfer t LEFT JOIN shop_erp_warehouse fw ON fw.id = t.from_warehouse_id AND fw.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_warehouse tw ON tw.id = t.to_warehouse_id AND tw.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON eu.id = t.user_id

(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ti.out_quantity), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory_transfer_item ti WHERE ti.transfer_id = t.id AND ti.is_deleted = 0) AS totalOut, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ti.receive_quantity), 0) FROM shop_erp_inventory_transfer_item ti WHERE ti.transfer_id = t.id AND ti.is_deleted = 0) AS totalReceive
mapper.select:
SELECT , , fw.warehouse_name AS fromWarehouseName, tw.warehouse_name AS toWarehouseName, fw.status AS fromWarehouseStatus, tw.status AS toWarehouseStatus, eu.nickname AS userName
WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0
